Original signed scene coordinates and finite support elevations form a checked completed root. The final mesh transformation and complete camera-frame calculation consume native vectors.

This is source inspection, not a numerical or renderer verdict.

traces.contract: The inspector passes checked scene corners intact rather than mapping them to native vectors in the caller. The full clipping operation projects internally. Its fixed nonempty four-corner minimum/maximum starts at the first real corner, without infinity seeds. LOD reporting accepts SupportElevation intact; an empty vertex set is None, while a nonfinite completed world elevation returns ObservationError::InvalidLodElevation.

traces.limit: Native affine triangle interpolation and final native JSON arithmetic remain; other report applicability and typed camera state are not claimed complete.
